title: BigQuery Agent Analytics
description: Interactive dashboard for the BigQuery Agent Analytics SDK (issue #339). Panels query the raw agent_events table and the typed ViewManager views (adk_* by default). Panel SQL is maintained in grafana/queries/*.sql — treat those files as the source of truth.

list.name: datasource
list.label: BigQuery datasource
list.description: The Grafana BigQuery data source to query.

list.name: project
list.label: GCP project
list.description: Google Cloud project containing the BQAA dataset.

list.name: dataset
list.label: BigQuery dataset
list.description: Dataset holding agent_events and the ViewManager views.

list.name: view_prefix
list.label: View prefix
list.description: Prefix ViewManager applies to view names (default adk_).

list.name: agent
list.label: Agent
list.description: Filter panels to one or more agents.

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}` WHERE agent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY agent

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT agent FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}` WHERE agent IS NOT NULL ORDER BY agent

list.name: session_id
list.label: Session
list.description: Session for the Trace detail panel. Referenced as ${session_id:sqlstring} so Grafana SQL-escapes it.

query.rawSql: SELECT session_id FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}` WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring}) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY MAX(timestamp) DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Distinct session_ids in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Overview stats (Sessions, Events, Error rate, Avg LLM latency).
-- One row, four columns; each Grafana stat panel picks one field.
-- NOTE: UPPER(status) = 'ERROR' is used instead of the SDK's
-- ERROR_SQL_PREDICATE because seed_events.py emits lowercase statuses.
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) AS events,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNTIF(UPPER(e.status) = 'ERROR'),
    COUNT(*)
  ) AS error_rate,
  (
    SELECT AVG(r.total_ms)
    FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses` AS r
    WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
      AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
  ) AS avg_llm_latency_ms
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}` AS e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.timestamp)
  AND e.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

panels.title: Avg LLM latency
panels.description: Mean total_ms across LLM responses. Stays empty (not 0) when latency telemetry is missing.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Overview stats (Sessions, Events, Error rate, Avg LLM latency).
-- One row, four columns; each Grafana stat panel picks one field.
-- NOTE: UPPER(status) = 'ERROR' is used instead of the SDK's
-- ERROR_SQL_PREDICATE because seed_events.py emits lowercase statuses.
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT e.session_id) AS sessions,
  COUNT(*) AS events,
  SAFE_DIVIDE(
    COUNTIF(UPPER(e.status) = 'ERROR'),
    COUNT(*)
  ) AS error_rate,
  (
    SELECT AVG(r.total_ms)
    FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses` AS r
    WHERE $__timeFilter(r.timestamp)
      AND r.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
  ) AS avg_llm_latency_ms
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}` AS e
WHERE $__timeFilter(e.timestamp)
  AND e.agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

-- Panel: Events over time, one series per event_type (Overview row).
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS time,
  event_type,
  COUNT(*) AS events
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time, event_type
ORDER BY time

-- Panel: Errors over time, one series per event_type (Overview row).
-- NOTE: UPPER(status) = 'ERROR' is the casing-safe predicate; the SDK's
-- ERROR_SQL_PREDICATE and seed_events.py disagree on status casing.
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS time,
  event_type,
  COUNT(*) AS errors
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
  AND UPPER(status) = 'ERROR'
GROUP BY time, event_type
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Token usage over time
panels.description: Prompt / completion / total tokens from ${view_prefix}llm_responses. Missing usage telemetry degrades to 0.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Token usage over time (LLM & FinOps row).
-- Uses the typed ${view_prefix}llm_responses view. Missing usage telemetry
-- degrades to 0 for sums (IFNULL) rather than dropping the bucket.
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS time,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_prompt_tokens, 0)) AS prompt_tokens,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_completion_tokens, 0)) AS completion_tokens,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_total_tokens, 0)) AS total_tokens
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: LLM latency (p50 / p95 / TTFT)
panels.description: Latency percentiles from ${view_prefix}llm_responses. Gaps mean missing latency telemetry.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: LLM latency percentiles + time-to-first-token (LLM & FinOps row).
-- Latency aggregates deliberately stay NULL when telemetry is missing so
-- the chart shows gaps instead of fake zeros.
SELECT
  $__timeGroup(timestamp, $__interval) AS time,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_ms, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_total_ms,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95_total_ms,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(ttft_ms, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_ttft_ms
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens by model
panels.description: Token totals grouped by model_version (response-side attribute).

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Tokens by model (LLM & FinOps row).
-- model_version is the response-side attribute exposed by the
-- ${view_prefix}llm_responses view; rows without it group under "unknown".
SELECT
  IFNULL(model_version, 'unknown') AS model,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_prompt_tokens, 0)) AS prompt_tokens,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_completion_tokens, 0)) AS completion_tokens,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_total_tokens, 0)) AS total_tokens,
  COUNT(*) AS responses
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY model
ORDER BY total_tokens DESC

panels.title: Estimated cost
panels.description: DERIVED estimate, not telemetry: token counts x placeholder per-1M-token rates. Edit the rates in grafana/queries/estimated_cost.sql to match your model pricing. Token counts are the primary FinOps signal.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: "Estimated Cost" stat (LLM & FinOps row).
-- Costs are DERIVED, not telemetry: the SDK records token counts only.
-- The per-1M-token rates below are placeholders — adjust them to the
-- pricing of the model(s) you actually run. The panel is intentionally
-- labeled "Estimated Cost" for this reason; token counts are the
-- primary FinOps signal.
SELECT
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_prompt_tokens, 0)) / 1e6 * 1.25    -- $ / 1M prompt tokens
    + SUM(IFNULL(usage_completion_tokens, 0)) / 1e6 * 5.00  -- $ / 1M completion tokens
    AS estimated_cost_usd,
  SUM(IFNULL(usage_total_tokens, 0)) AS total_tokens
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}llm_responses`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

-- Panel: Tool invocations by tool (Tools row).
-- Uses the typed ${view_prefix}tool_completions view.
SELECT
  tool_name,
  COUNT(*) AS invocations
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}tool_completions`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY invocations DESC

panels.title: Tool latency
panels.description: Per-tool latency; NULLs mean missing latency telemetry.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Tool latency by tool (Tools row).
-- Latency stays NULL when missing (no IFNULL) so averages aren't skewed.
SELECT
  tool_name,
  COUNT(*) AS invocations,
  AVG(total_ms) AS avg_ms,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_ms, 100)[OFFSET(50)] AS p50_ms,
  APPROX_QUANTILES(total_ms, 100)[OFFSET(95)] AS p95_ms
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}tool_completions`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY p95_ms DESC

-- Panel: Tool errors (Tools row).
-- Combines the dedicated TOOL_ERROR view with any error-status completions.
-- NOTE: UPPER(status) = 'ERROR' is the casing-safe predicate (see
-- queries/README.md).
SELECT
  timestamp,
  agent,
  session_id,
  tool_name,
  error_message
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}tool_errors`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})

UNION ALL

SELECT
  timestamp,
  agent,
  session_id,
  tool_name,
  error_message
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${view_prefix}tool_completions`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
  AND UPPER(status) = 'ERROR'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Recent sessions
panels.description: Session rollups over the raw ${table} table. Pick a session_id in the dashboard variable above to inspect its trace below.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Recent sessions (Sessions & Traces row).
-- Session-level rollup over the raw agent_events table.
-- NOTE: UPPER(status) = 'ERROR' is the casing-safe predicate (see
-- queries/README.md).
SELECT
  session_id,
  MIN(timestamp) AS started_at,
  MAX(timestamp) AS last_event_at,
  TIMESTAMP_DIFF(MAX(timestamp), MIN(timestamp), SECOND) AS duration_s,
  COUNT(DISTINCT agent) AS agents,
  COUNT(*) AS events,
  COUNTIF(UPPER(status) = 'ERROR') AS errors
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}`
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND agent IN (${agent:sqlstring})
GROUP BY session_id
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Trace detail — $session_id
panels.description: Full event timeline for the selected session. model is COALESCE($.model, $.model_version) since requests and responses store it under different attribute keys.

targets.rawSql:
-- Panel: Trace detail for the selected $session_id (Sessions & Traces row).
-- Queries the raw table so every event type appears in one timeline.
-- - ${session_id:sqlstring} lets Grafana SQL-escape the value (injection-safe).
-- - COALESCE(model, model_version): `model` exists on LLM_REQUEST attributes,
--   `model_version` on LLM_RESPONSE attributes — one column covers both.
SELECT
  timestamp,
  event_type,
  agent,
  invocation_id,
  span_id,
  parent_span_id,
  status,
  COALESCE(
    JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.model'),
    JSON_VALUE(attributes, '$.model_version')
  ) AS model,
  JSON_VALUE(content, '$.tool') AS tool_name,
  CAST(JSON_VALUE(latency_ms, '$.total_ms') AS INT64) AS total_ms,
  error_message
FROM `${project}.${dataset}.${table}`
WHERE session_id = ${session_id:sqlstring}
ORDER BY timestamp
LIMIT 500
